prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `LineDraft`, `InvoiceTotals`, and `InvoiceBook`. A draft has `code`, `description`, `unitCents`, `units`, and `rebateCentsPerUnit`. `InvoiceBook` must support `begin`, `save`, `cancel`, `delete`, `search`, `resetSearch`, `visible`, and `totals`. Only one draft may be pending. `save` and `cancel` must throw when none is pending. Codes and trimmed descriptions must be nonempty; codes are unique; all numeric fields must be safe integers; `unitCents` must be nonnegative, `units` positive, and rebates between zero and the unit price. Saved lines retain insertion order. Search is case-insensitive substring matching on descriptions, an empty query matches all lines, and reset restores all lines. Deleting an unknown code returns false. `subtotalCents` is the sum of `(unitCents - rebateCentsPerUnit) * units`; tax is 8%, rounded to the nearest integer cent with `Math.round`; total is subtotal plus tax. Inputs and returned values must be copied so callers cannot mutate internal state.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
